Proof in the paper: The X-ray diffraction (XRD) data presented in Figure 1 confirm the formation of the cubic spinel (Fd3m) phase for all the four morphologies: cubic, spherical, octahedral, and truncated octahedral. The diffraction peaks at 18.82°, 36.34°, 44.20°, and 64.36° correspond, respectively, to the (111), (311), (400), and (440) planes of spinel LiMn1.5Ni0.5O4 (JCPDS 32-0581).
